scenario.title: 三個月試用期面談
scenario.context: 第三章的收尾：試用期結束的一對一面談。你要回顧已經完成的事（過去式）、到現在累積的成果（現在完成式）、一直在努力的方向（現在完成進行式），還要回應讚美和建議。前面九個職場單元的句型全部會用上。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: So, you've been with us for three months now. How do you feel it's gone?
lines.zh: 你來我們這裡三個月了。你覺得進行得怎樣？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Honestly, it's been great. I've learned a lot, especially about working with bigger clients.
lines.zh: 說真的很棒。我學到很多，特別是跟大客戶合作的部分。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: I agree. You've really stepped up. The tea packaging project was a big win.
lines.zh: 我同意，你真的有挺身而出。茶飲包裝案是一大勝利。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Thank you. That project was tough. We were finalizing the illustrations when the client changed the whole concept.
lines.zh: 謝謝。那個案子很硬，我們在定稿插圖時客戶把整個概念改掉了。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: And you still delivered on time. That's what I mean by going the extra mile.
lines.zh: 而你還是準時交件，這就是我說的多走一哩路。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I couldn't have done it without the team, though. Daniel covered for me a lot.
lines.zh: 不過沒有團隊我做不到，Daniel 幫我擋了很多事。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: That's why you're a good fit here. Everyone pulls their weight.
lines.zh: 這就是你適合這裡的原因，每個人都盡自己的本分。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Is there anything you'd like to work on?
lines.zh: 有什麼是你想加強的嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I've been trying to speak up more in client meetings. I don't think I'm there yet.
lines.zh: 我一直在努力在客戶會議上多發言，但我覺得還沒做到。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: I've noticed. You made a great point in the noodle brand meeting, didn't you?
lines.zh: 我有注意到。你在麵品牌那場會議上提了很好的觀點，對吧？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: The orange idea? Yeah, I was nervous, but I'm glad I said something.
lines.zh: 橘色那個點子嗎？對，我很緊張，但很高興我有講。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Keep doing that. Also, you dropped the ball on file checks once. Just stay on the ball with that.
lines.zh: 繼續保持。另外，你有一次檔案檢查漏掉了，這部分要保持警覺。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Definitely. We've added a checklist since then, and there haven't been any mistakes.
lines.zh: 一定。從那之後我們加了檢查清單，就再也沒出錯過。

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.en: Perfect. Well, I'm happy to say you've passed your probation. Welcome to the team, officially.
lines.zh: 太好了。很高興告訴你，你通過試用期了。正式歡迎加入團隊。

patterns.en: How do you feel it's gone?

patterns.zh: 我在 ___ 方面學到很多。

patterns.en: I'm proud of how ___ turned out.
patterns.zh: 我對 ___ 的成果很滿意。

patterns.en: I couldn't have done it without ___.
patterns.note: 接受稱讚時把功勞分出去

patterns.en: I don't think I'm there yet.
What would you like to see from me?
patterns.zh: 你希望我在哪方面多表現？

chinglish.wrong: No no no, I am not good, everyone is better.
chinglish.right: Thank you, I really appreciate that. The team helped a lot.
chinglish.why: 中文習慣用否認回應稱讚表示謙虛，英文會讓對方覺得你在反駁他的判斷。先說 thank you，再分享功勞（第 37 單元會詳細講）。

chinglish.wrong: I have done the tea project in May.
chinglish.right: I did the tea project in May.
chinglish.why: 有明確時間 in May，用過去式（複習第 12、21 單元）。

chinglish.wrong: I am trying to speak more since last month.
chinglish.right: I've been trying to speak up more since last month.
chinglish.why: since + 持續到現在的努力，用現在完成進行式（複習第 26 單元）。

chinglish.right: I'd love the chance to take on more responsibility.
chinglish.why: chance 可數，要加 a 或用 more chances；而且主動表達想承擔什麼比「請給機會」更有力。

grammar.title: 完成／過去／完成進行 對照
grammar.oneLiner: 過去式講「那時候」，現在完成式講「到現在的成果」，現在完成進行式講「到現在的努力過程」。
whenToUse: 過去式：已結束、有明確時間的事件。The client changed the concept last month.
過去進行式：當時正在進行的背景。We were finalizing the illustrations when…
現在完成式：到目前為止的成果、經驗、數量。I've learned a lot. / I've finished three projects.
現在完成進行式：到現在為止持續的努力或動作，可能還在繼續。I've been trying to speak up more.
判斷訣竅：有 yesterday / in May / last week → 過去式；有 so far / since / for / yet → 完成式系列。
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 這一章每個時態都是從同一個問題延伸出來的：中文用「了」「過」「一直」「正在」來標時間，英文把這些資訊放進動詞形態。績效面談正好是四種時態交錯出現的場合，講錯了可能讓主管誤會你的成果已經結束、或者還沒開始。說話前先想：我要講的是某個時間點、到現在的成果，還是到現在的過程？

examples.correct: I joined the team in June, and I've worked on five projects since then.
examples.note: 加入是過去的時間點；做了幾個案子是到現在的累積。

examples.correct: I've been working on my presentation skills.
examples.incorrect: I work on my presentation skills since June.
examples.note: 持續的努力用完成進行式。

examples.correct: We were testing the site when we found the bug.
There haven't been any mistakes since we added the checklist.
examples.note: since + 到現在的結果，用現在完成式。

examples.correct: Have you finished the report yet? — Not yet, but I've been working on it all day.
examples.note: 結果用完成式，過程用完成進行式。

quiz.question: I ___ the company in March.
quiz.explanation: 有明確時間 in March，用過去式。

quiz.question: Since then, I ___ four client projects.
quiz.explanation: since + 到現在的成果，用現在完成式。

quiz.question: I've ___ (try) to improve my English for a year now.
quiz.explanation: 持續的努力用現在完成進行式。

quiz.question: We ___ the final files when the client called.
quiz.explanation: 被打斷的背景用過去進行式。

slang.meaning: 盡自己的本分、做好該做的份
slang.usage: 團隊中每個人都分擔工作。常用否定：He's not pulling his weight（他沒盡本分）。

risk.note: 說別人 not pulling their weight 是很重的批評，當面說要謹慎。

examples.en: Everyone on this team pulls their weight.
examples.zh: 這個團隊每個人都盡了本分。

examples.en: I feel like I'm not pulling my weight since I got sick.
examples.zh: 我生病之後覺得自己沒盡到本分。

slang.meaning: 多做一點、超出期待的努力
slang.usage: 做超過本分的事，讓成果更好。

risk.note: 正面稱讚，履歷和面談很常見。

examples.en: She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
examples.zh: 她總是為客戶多做一點。

examples.en: Thanks for going the extra mile on this project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在這個案子上格外用心。

slang.meaning: 反應快、很機靈、狀況掌握得好
slang.usage: 形容人很能幹、注意力集中。stay on the ball = 保持警覺。

examples.en: Our new intern is really on the ball.
examples.zh: 我們的新實習生反應超快。

examples.en: I need more coffee. I'm not on the ball today.
examples.zh: 我需要更多咖啡，今天腦袋不太靈光。

slang.usage: 在需要的時候主動承擔責任：You really stepped up. / step up to the plate。

risk.note: 職場常見的稱讚或期許。

examples.en: When our manager was out, Amy stepped up and led the team.
examples.zh: 主管不在的時候，Amy 挺身而出帶領團隊。

examples.en: We need someone to step up and take charge of this.
examples.zh: 我們需要有人站出來負責這件事。

review.question: You've worked here for three months, ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 29 單元：You've = You have，用 haven't you。

review.question: Sorry, that's ___ me. I'll fix it right away.
review.explanation: 複習第 28 單元：That's on me = 是我的錯。

review.question: I was wondering ___ I could work from home on Fridays.
review.explanation: 複習第 27 單元：yes/no 間接問句用 if。

review.question: The project is ___ track, so we'll launch on time.
My manager ___ me take Friday off.
review.explanation: 複習第 24 單元：允許用 let。

review.question: A: Would you mind staying late tonight? B: ___ (你答應)
review.explanation: 複習第 23 單元：Not at all。

review.question: Which is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 22 單元：agree 是動詞。

review.question: I've decided ___ a design course next year.
review.explanation: 複習第 14 單元：decide + to V。

review.question: When the manager was sick, Amy stepped ___ and ran the meeting.
